sources.entry: mac2imgur - Simple Mac app designed to make uploading images and screenshots to Imgur quick and effortless.

summary.one_liner: A macOS menu bar app that automatically uploads screenshots and manually chosen images to imgur.com and copies the resulting link to the clipboard.
summary.what_it_does: mac2imgur watches for new screenshots taken with the built-in macOS screenshot shortcuts (full screen, rectangular selection, window or menu capture) and uploads them to Imgur. Images can also be uploaded manually by dragging them onto the status bar icon or by using the "Upload Images…" menu option. After a successful upload, the direct link is copied to the clipboard and a notification is shown. Preferences cover launch at login, clearing the clipboard during uploads, deleting the original screenshot after upload, disabling detection, requiring confirmation before upload, and downscaling Retina screenshots. Screenshot save location, file format, and filename prefix can be changed through macOS `defaults` commands.
use_cases: Quickly sharing a screenshot via an Imgur link
Uploading images to Imgur from the Mac menu bar
Reducing Retina screenshot size before uploading
Confirming screenshots before they are posted online
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the project's releases page (macOS 10.9+)
notable: Watches macOS screenshot shortcuts and uploads automatically
Copies the direct Imgur link to the clipboard after upload
Optional confirmation dialog before each upload
Drag-and-drop uploads onto the status bar icon
Screenshot format, location and name customizable via macOS defaults
caveats: The project is no longer actively maintained
Written in Swift 3, an older language version
Changing the screenshot location requires restarting mac2imgur and SystemUIServer
